content.text: In the Philippines, [[LINK:https://coremerch.[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/github-pages-free-digital-product-store-hosting-everything|GitHub Pages]].io/store/blog/digital-product-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-what-nobody-tells-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-solutions-west-africa-explained-digital|digital]] creators face a stark reality: global payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or severely restricted. This isn’t just an inconvenience—it’s a barrier to earning from your work. Google Apps Script, often overlooked, becomes a powerful tool in this context. It’s not a workaround but a foundational piece of sovereign commerce infrastructure. Paired with GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto processing, it creates a stack you own outright. No subscriptions. No platform lock-in. This architecture is pressure-tested in environments like Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and financial isolation are daily realities. It’s built for creators who choose ownership over dependency.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a cloud-based JavaScript platform that runs on Google’s infrastructure. It’s not just for automating spreadsheets—it’s a backend engine capable of handling order processing, payment verification, and file delivery. For digital creators in the Philippines, this means you can build a fully operational online store without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or any other third-party payment processor. The stack integrates with NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges a flat 0.5% fee. This eliminates the need for buyer accounts or KYC, making it accessible to anyone with a crypto wallet. The frontend is hosted on GitHub Pages, a free and reliable platform that requires no server management. Orders are stored in Google Sheets, a familiar and free tool that doubles as a lightweight database. This architecture is sovereign by design—you own every component, and COREMERCH has no access after deployment.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The pipeline starts when a buyer sends crypto to the payment address generated by NOWPayments. A webhook fires the moment the transaction confirms on-chain, triggering a Google Apps Script function. This script verifies the payment, logs the order in Google Sheets, and sends a delivery email via Gmail. The digital product is stored in Google Drive, and the download link is included in the email. Every step is automated, from payment verification to file delivery. The script handles errors gracefully—if a payment fails, the buyer receives a notification without manual intervention. This system is lightweight but robust, designed to operate without ongoing maintenance. It’s not just a script; it’s a complete commerce stack that runs on free, globally accessible tools.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is for digital creators who sell ebooks, courses, templates, or software but cannot use conventional payment platforms. It’s for those who value ownership over convenience, who refuse to be locked out of their own earnings. In the Philippines, where financial infrastructure is fragmented, this stack provides a reliable alternative. It’s also for creators in other regions like Nigeria, Kenya, and Venezuela, where similar restrictions apply. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates needed to deploy this stack in hours, not weeks. It’s not a temporary solution—it’s a permanent shift to infrastructure sovereignty. You’re not renting a platform; you’re building a system that stays operational even if COREMERCH ceases to exist.
Google Apps Script is not just for spreadsheets—it’s a full backend engine for digital commerce.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages hosts the frontend, a static site that displays your products and collects buyer details. Google Apps Script handles backend logic, from payment verification to email delivery. Google Sheets stores order data, acting as a simple but effective database. NOWPayments processes crypto payments, firing a webhook the moment a transaction confirms. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 stores the digital products, with download links generated dynamically. Resend or Gmail sends delivery emails, ensuring buyers receive their purchases instantly. Each component is free or low-cost, and the entire stack is designed for minimal maintenance. The Complete Builder Kit includes step-by-step guides for integrating these components, ensuring you can deploy without technical guesswork.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by mapping your product flow: how buyers will discover, purchase, and receive your digital goods. Use the Complete Builder Kit to deploy the stack on GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script. Configure NOWPayments to generate payment addresses and fire webhooks. Set up Google Sheets to log orders and Google Drive to store files. Test the pipeline end-to-end before going live. The kit includes templates for every step, from payment verification scripts to email delivery logic. Once deployed, you own the entire system—no ongoing fees, no platform dependencies. This isn’t a temporary fix; it’s a permanent solution to a systemic problem. It’s how you reclaim control over your digital commerce.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Map your product flow: Identify how buyers will discover, purchase, and receive your digital products. 2. Deploy the frontend on GitHub Pages using the templates from the Complete Builder Kit. 3. Configure NOWPayments to generate payment addresses and fire webhooks upon confirmation. 4. Set up Google Sheets to log orders and Google Drive to store digital files. 5. Write or copy the Google Apps Script logic for payment verification and email delivery. 6. Test the pipeline end-to-end, ensuring payments trigger file delivery without manual intervention. 7. Go live and monitor the system for errors, using the kit’s troubleshooting guides as needed.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes step-by-step guides and pre-built templates for every component. You don’t need to write code from scratch—just follow the instructions to deploy the stack.
What happens if a payment fails?

The system sends a notification to the buyer automatically, without manual intervention. The script is designed to handle errors gracefully, ensuring a smooth experience even when payments don’t go through.
Do I need to manage servers?
No. The frontend is hosted on GitHub Pages, and the backend runs on Google’s infrastructure. There’s no server management required—the stack is fully cloud-based.
Can I add more products after deployment?
Yes. The system is designed to scale. You can add new products by updating the frontend and backend logic, using the templates provided in the Complete Builder Kit.
What if I want to switch payment processors later?
The architecture is modular. You can replace NOWPayments with another processor by updating the webhook integration. The kit includes guides for integrating multiple payment gateways.
